The `.npmrc` sets the registry for `@sw-code` scope, and the lockfile may include some entries from the Github registry. Let me search the lockfile for `npm.pkg.github.com` in resolution fields.

Actually the comparison `comm -23 lock ws` showed empty (all lock @sw-code names are workspace). But maybe some are dependencies bundled. Let me search the lock for "npm.pkg.github".

Actually let me step back. The important question: can I complete `just up` without a GITHUB_TOKEN? The preflight hard-fails. But maybe I can set a dummy token and the build will still work if the token is never actually used for authenticated access — since dependencies come from public sources.

But wait, `@sw-code` npm packages: are they published on npm.pkg.github.com? If app has external @sw-code deps, pnpm install would need auth. But we found all @sw-code in lock are workspace. Let me double-check by looking at lock entries with "resolution" that aren't workspace/link.

Let me search lock for 'npm.pkg.github' and also for @sw-code with version (not link).
